programs.name: vm_audio_one_second
programs.description: Record a one-second PCM WAV to ESP SD; sample count is returned in r1. Writes an audio file.

programs.name: vm_camera_once
programs.description: Capture one numbered JPEG to ESP SD and halt; sequence number is returned in r0.

programs.name: vm_camera_sequence
programs.description: Start the native five-photo sequence with one-second intervals; sequence continues after VM halts. Writes SD JPEGs.

programs.name: vm_dht11_once
programs.description: Wait 2100 ms for DHT11 startup, read temperature plus humidity detail, then halt.

programs.name: vm_env_thread
programs.description: Start continuous temperature/humidity sampling every 2500 ms, saving timestamped SD CSV files; explicitly stop the thread when finished.

programs.name: vm_ir_scan
programs.description: Start the default ten-second native IR capture thread. A known remote/source is needed to verify reception; it does not replay IR.

programs.name: vm_ir_transmit_sequence
programs.description: Start five short carrier bursts using the native IR sequence. Emits IR; requires an explicit receiver/target fixture.

programs.name: vm_led_blink
programs.description: Continuous onboard RGB LED blink with a dim green value of 8 and 500 ms steps; stopping VM may leave its last state.

programs.name: vm_light_change_start
programs.description: Start dynamic light-change detection at 250 ms with a 200-count margin, then halt; baseline comes from current readings.

programs.name: vm_light_once
programs.description: Read current photoresistor ADC with the default sample count and halt; r0 contains the reading.

programs.name: vm_mic_rise_start
programs.description: Start the rolling ten-bucket loudness detector at 200% ratio and minimum RMS 20, then halt. Missing HALT fixed during catalog review.

programs.name: vm_police_lights
programs.description: Continuous blue/red alternation every 125 ms using LED_EXTERNAL. Stopping VM can leave one LED on; use the finite police sequence normally.

programs.name: vm_police_on_all
programs.description: Start ultrasonic, light and loudness detectors plus Neo mascot/status display; any event triggers the finite police sequence. Requires updated ESP function 269 and /img/Iris_formatted.gif on Neo.

programs.name: vm_police_on_any_change
programs.description: Run all three detectors and finite police flashes without requiring Neo or OLED; previous stable fallback.

programs.name: vm_police_on_loudness_rise
programs.description: Trigger police flashes when newer five-second mean loudness is twice older five-second mean, above RMS 20.

programs.name: vm_police_on_sensor_change
programs.description: Run ultrasonic and dynamic light-change detectors; either event triggers finite police flashes. Light sampling pauses during LED activity.

programs.name: vm_police_on_ultrasonic_change
programs.description: Poll 100 mm ultrasonic changes at 250 ms and trigger police flashes; coalesce events while flashing.

programs.name: vm_police_sequence_vm
programs.description: Configure two 200 ms LED tracks from VM registers for ten alternating flashes in two seconds; both end off. Native sequence completes after VM halts.

programs.name: vm_radio_status
programs.description: Read Wi-Fi status into r0 and BLE connection state into r1, then halt; no scan or reconfiguration.

programs.name: vm_rssi_scan
programs.description: Start the default ten-second native RSSI scan thread; snapshots are saved as timestamped SD CSV files.

programs.name: vm_rssi_ten_seconds
programs.description: Retired: uses removed RSSI_ON/OFF (112/113). Use vm_rssi_scan and the common sampling thread instead.

programs.name: vm_sound_capture
programs.description: Measure MIC_ABOVE with threshold 50; capture JPEG after a loud sample, wait three seconds, then resume polling at 250 ms. Writes SD photos.

programs.name: vm_sound_capture_test
programs.description: Same sound/camera flow with RMS threshold 1; controlled integration fixture only, can repeatedly write photos.

programs.name: vm_storage_mic
programs.description: Read SD capacity into r0 and microphone RMS into r1, then halt; no test files created.

programs.name: vm_ultrasonic_change_start
programs.description: Start the native ultrasonic detector at 250 ms with a 100 mm delta, then halt. Stop the native thread explicitly when finished.

programs.name: vm_video_one_second
programs.description: Retired: calls removed CAMERA_VIDEO (107) to make two-frame MJPEG. Do not run on cleaned-up firmware; use camera sequences and Neo assembly.

programs.name: arithmetic
programs.description: Compute 7 + 5 into r2 and halt; hardware-independent VM smoke test.

programs.name: time_now
programs.description: Read logical monotonic milliseconds into r0 and halt; no timer reset.

programs.name: time_reset
programs.description: Reset the logical timer to zero and halt; changes timestamps used by running programs, so test in isolation.
